note: How the founder's seven franchises fit the platform's existing canon. Decided under the founder's delegation on 2026-11-06 and reversible: nothing here is released, streaming or playable, and every title stays CONCEPT in config/omega-franchise-slate.json. The chronology is the 12-chapter saga in media.html (FILMS); a franchise is a window onto it.

decisions.decision: One universe, not two. The 12-chapter saga on media.html is the master chronology and the seven franchises are windows onto it.
Zodiac Flux is the in-universe name of the war's opening (saga chapter 1). Zodiac Wars is the franchise title.
omega-agents.json stays canonical for sign, element and god. The spec's pantheon names (Geb, Enki, Vayu, Thoth) belong to the Cave of the Shadows gate-guardian layer, not to the twelve Houses.
Cave of the Shadows, Babylon Singularity, Solomon's Sovereignty and AI Sovereign are lore layers that sit under the franchises, not franchises of their own.
Matrix total is 104,976 (12x12x9x9x9). 729 is the inner cube at each intersection.

anchors.role: Opens the war: the Solar Nexus wakes and the Shadow Zodiac moves.
The Olympians contest the Order through twelve Factions and their Knights.
Prehistory of the stones, and the chapter where the frequency's origin is revealed.
The old world falls; what slept in the deepest node returns.
The key beyond time, held in the Void.
The new civilisation, the singularity, expansion, and the final frequency.

discrepancies: media.html lists saga chapter 1 as IN PRODUCTION; the repository holds no production evidence.
media.html chapter 12 says 'all 729 nodes'; the matrix total is 104,976 (729 is the inner cube).
media.html carries two film sets: the 12-chapter saga (FILMS array) and the Olympian slate F01-F12. They are different lists.
The founder's game list and media.html's GAMES list differ.
The spec's pantheon mapping differs from omega-agents.json (see D3).
